assumptions: The Spring XD modules are well-documented and have comprehensive test suites that can be migrated
Each module has similar complexity and requires similar migration effort
The developer is familiar with both Spring XD and Spring Cloud Stream architectures
No significant refactoring of module internals is required - only dependency and build changes
Existing tests can be adapted to the new project structure with minimal modifications
The Spring Cloud Stream project structure is consistent across all existing modules
Documentation exists for all modules and can be adapted for the new location
The migration process is straightforward copy-and-adapt with no architectural changes needed
